profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dandelion Health
profile.summary:
Software Engineer/Full Stack

Python | Django | SQL | AWS | Docker | PostgreSQL | CI/CD | API

Artificial Intelligence/Claude/Github CoPilot

Designing and developing microservices for ETL processes

Experience with Python, AWS, APIs, Django, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, Cloudformation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing microservices using Python and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, EC2, ECS, SQS, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, Step Functions, API Gateway, Route53)
- Implement scalable solutions for handling big data processes
- Python, Django, Postgres

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Replacing existing Wonderware ArchestrA applications into Ignition.
- Integrating High Performance HMI interfaces for industrial process control systems
- Implementing tag definition schemes
- Writing scripts to help automate the development process and replicate existing functionality
- Troubleshooting and maintaining existing control system applications
- Working with Field Automation Specialists, plant engineers, operators, and management to develop and manage current projects
- Preparing and delivering 30%, 60%, and 90% review presentations

Tech Used:
- Inductive Automation Ignition HMI/SCADA Software
- Python/Jython/SQL
- Git
- SQL Server Management Studio
- Open Platform Communication
- Allen Bradley, Control Logix, MicroLogix, and Modicon PLC devices
- Kepware 
- Wonderware ArchestrA and InTouch Applications

positions.title: Instructional Student Assistant
positions.description:
I assisted a faculty member, Dr. Albert Cruz, to grade assignments, proctor exams, record grades in the grade book. Also, I administered introductory lectures of lab concepts, and was responsible for conducting and aiding students during the lab session.
We discussed and conducted labs on Computer Network concepts like:
- Command Line Networking Tools (dig, ping, traceroute)
- Basic TCP/IP Communication
- Full Duplex Communication
- SSH Protocol
- OSI Layer Model
- Wireshark

positions.title: Minority Science and Engineering Improvement Program-2
positions.description:
Summer Research Program at California State University of Bakersfield
With professor Dr. Yiannis Ampatzidis
- Used and programmed mechatronics: micro-sensors (e.g soil moisture, solar radiation, air temperature and humidity) and micro-electronics.
- Worked on a personal project developing a 3D printed autonomous/remote-controlled robot using C++, Arduino, etc. (Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence)

positions.title: Minority Science and Engineering Improvement Program-2
positions.description:
Summer Research Program at California State University of Bakersfield
With professor Dr. Vida Vakilian
- Experimented interfacing with multiple devices in LabVIEW by testing and controlling designed
circuits
- Focused on measurement and signal processing analysis from device input into graphical
representations (data analysis)

projects.title: Android - C++ Quiz Game
projects.description:
Android C++ Quiz Game developed using Unity Game Engine and C#
Objective: Learning tool for C++ beginners

projects.title: Android - Super Stacker
projects.description:
Android Game developed using Unity Game Engine and C#
Objective: Stack as many blocks as possible
